2610.11948.title: When History Helps and Hurts: Selective History Use across Multimodal Turns
2610.11948.paper_summary: Reliable multimodal interaction depends on selective use of conversational history: an earlier question may remain relevant while its previous answer is outdated, whereas a current request may depend on historical evidence despite conflicting new observations. Existing multi-turn evaluations rarely separate these history-use demands from underlying question difficulty. To address this gap, we introduce ReTurn, a benchmark of 7,000 base tasks spanning visual and audio evidence for evaluating selective history use. For task-carrying history, Reconfirm/Reground require applying a historical question to current media while varying historical agreement; for evidence-carrying history, Retrieve/Rebind require answering a current question using historical media while varying current-media competition. Each pair preserves the target question, media, and answer. Tasks support open-ended and multiple-choice evaluation, with matched single-turn counterparts serving as answerability references. Across 13 omni-modal, vision-language, and audio-language models, median model-level open-ended accuracy falls from 93.7% with direct input to 72.3% in conversation. Behavioral probes show that high question recall can coexist with weaker task application, while competing media can redirect answers away from historical targets. Supervised adaptation yields only partial gains. ReTurn provides a controlled framework for assessing whether multimodal models select and use the historical information required by each request.
2610.11948.paper_summary_zh: 可靠的多模態互動依賴於對對話歷史的選擇性使用：早期的問題可能仍然相關，而其之前的答案則可能已過時，儘管當前的請求可能依賴於歷史證據，儘管存在相互矛盾的新觀察。現有的多輪評估很少將這些歷史使用需求與基本問題難度分開。為了填補這一空白，我們引入了 ReTurn，一個包含 7,000 個基礎任務的基準，涵蓋視覺和音頻證據，以評估選擇性歷史使用。對於任務承載的歷史，Reconfirm/Reground 需要將歷史問題應用於當前媒體，同時變化歷史一致性；對於證據承載的歷史，Retrieve/Rebind 需要使用歷史媒體回答當前問題，同時變化當前媒體的競爭。每對任務保留目標問題、媒體和答案。任務支持開放式和多選評估，匹配的單輪對應任務作為可回答性參考。在 13 個全模態、視覺-語言和音頻-語言模型中，中位數模型級別的開放式準確率從直接輸入的 93.7% 下降到對話中的 72.3%。行為探測顯示，高問題回憶可以與較弱的任務應用共存，而競爭媒體可以將答案從歷史目標轉移。監督適應僅帶來部分增益。ReTurn 提供了一個受控框架，用於評估多模態模型是否選擇並使用每個請求所需的歷史信息。
